query: Design the review step before a purchasing assistant commits an order. Prepare exact items, prices, recipients, and material risks, then specify approver authority, expiry, rejection, and safe continuation.
Our agent asks permission for every harmless lookup but sends consequential messages without a preview. Create a proportional action-to-gate table that preserves valid standing authorization.
An assistant proposes a bulk account change. Show a concrete diff, allow item-level rejection, bind approval to the exact arguments, and handle changed state before commit.

We need an escalation flow when a research assistant cannot obtain enough evidence for a consequential recommendation. Specify what the reviewer sees, what decisions they can make, and safe timeout behavior.

Approval fatigue is causing users to click through agent actions. Redesign batching and bounded standing grants, measure review burden, and preserve meaningful scrutiny of financial and destructive effects.
An agent waits for a manager to approve a refund while continuing unrelated authorized work. Specify pending, denied, expired, and cancelled states and prevent silence from becoming approval.

Design preview-before-send for an assistant draft with attachments and multiple recipients. Complete reversible preparation first, identify an authorized reviewer, and invalidate approval if recipients or content materially change.
A reviewer approved yesterday's proposal, but today's resource state differs. Define the user-facing re-review, grant binding, cancellation, and resume behavior around a fresh policy decision.

Help choose where humans should enter a maintenance agent workflow. Compare impact, reversibility, evidence gaps, and existing user authorization; deliver one exact decision preview and a gate contract.

Our AI workflow exposes an approve button for actions that violate a hard reserve rule. Redesign the decision experience so users understand denials, authorized exceptions, and their actual authority.

Implement a trusted grant verifier binding principal, action digest, state version, expiry, and use count. The review experience is already approved; focus exclusively on atomic admission and denied-state invariants.
Compose input checks, schema validation, permission gates, output grounding, and runtime limits for an agent. Review outages and contradictory layers using the existing approval interface.
The coding project has an approved specification. Write a task-by-task implementation plan with files, signatures, tests, and execution handoff; we are not designing a product approval workflow.

Create a specification for a new conventional web feature and identify open requirements before coding. Follow the existing development review stages rather than adding runtime human approval to an AI system.
Threat-model forged approval text in retrieved documents and malicious tool results. Verify trusted capability boundaries stop the attack; the human decision flow itself is fixed.
Design model output variants for proposed changes, refusal, and insufficient evidence. Keep application approval logic unchanged and focus on parsing, semantic validation, and bounded repair.
We already have grants and reviewer screens. Persist their pending IDs and policy versions in durable agent checkpoints, preserving expiry and budgets across compaction and restart.
Our chatbot only drafts advisory summaries and performs authorized read-only searches. Improve its production prompt, evidence requirements, and abstention behavior without adding action approvals.
Build evaluation tasks that measure agent accuracy and safety on approved versus denied operations. Keep the gate design fixed and calibrate scoring against existing policy and human labels.
Diagnose why a conventional background job retries an expired access token. Reproduce the bug, inspect configuration propagation, and implement a test-backed fix rather than changing human review.
